quote: On the afternoon of June 27, 2025, local time in Chile, PowerChina International Group Limited-Chile Branch, HDEC, and GM Developments SpA formally signed the EPC general contract for the Dune Plus Photovoltaic Storage Project in Chile.
note: Opened HDEC English page; EPC signed 27 Jun 2025; 186 MWp + multi-GWh storage scope; CapEx blank.
